rules.rationale: This is the base equation of the named mathematical summary oddDigitProduct: with no remaining digits, it returns the accumulator.
This is the positive-input recurrence for oddDigitProduct, decomposing N into parity, decimal quotient, decimal digit, and accumulator arguments for oddDigitStep.
This equation defines the oddDigitStep case in which the current digit is not odd, preserving the accumulator and continuing with the quotient.
This equation defines the oddDigitStep case for the first odd digit, replacing the zero sentinel accumulator with that digit.
This equation defines the oddDigitStep case for a later odd digit, multiplying it into a nonzero accumulator.

This simplifier asserts the non-odd-digit recurrence as an equality fact used during target comparison; it was present in verification.k before kprove ran and has no separate Stage 1 proof against a module omitting it.

This simplifier asserts the first-odd-digit recurrence for a zero accumulator; Stage 1 trusted it in the compiled verification definition rather than first proving its exact statement without the rule.
This simplifier asserts the later-odd-digit multiplication recurrence for a nonzero accumulator; it was available to the Stage 1 proof from compilation onward and was not separately established.
